summary: Jigsaw, matching, sorting and 9 more puzzle games for kids 2-6 years.
description:
Kids Puzzle is a big, joyful collection of 12 educational puzzle games made just for toddlers, preschoolers, and kindergarten kids. Bright pictures, gentle voice-overs, and happy celebrations turn learning into playtime your little one won't want to put down — and every game is designed for tiny fingers and curious minds.

From first-ever jigsaws for 2-year-olds to picture sudoku for older kids, there's a puzzle for every age and every mood. 🧩

🎮 12 FUN GAMES IN ONE APP
• Jigsaw Puzzles – classic drag-and-drop fun with 4, 9, 16 and 25-piece boards
• Shaped Jigsaw – snap uniquely shaped pieces into place
• Tap & Rotate – turn pieces to complete the picture with 9, 16, 25-piece boards
• Object Puzzles – piece together lovable objects and characters
• Slot Puzzles – match each piece to its spot
• Shape Matching – spot the shape and place it in the right position
• Shadow Matching – match each object to its shadow
• Picture Sudoku – logic made easy with pictures, not numbers
• Sorting Games – sort items into the right baskets
• Card Match – flip and find the matching pairs (memory game)
• Find the Difference – find what's changed between two pictures
• Scene Builder – get creative and design your own scenes

🐾 LOTS TO EXPLORE
Play across wonderful themes kids love: Animals, Birds, Fruits, Insects, Sea Creatures, Vehicles, and Seasons — with new puzzles to discover in every category.

🧠 LEARNING THROUGH PLAY
While they play, kids naturally build:
• Fine motor skills & hand-eye coordination
• Problem-solving & spatial reasoning
• Visual memory & concentration
• Sorting and grouping
• Shape, color & object recognition

Friendly voice-overs, colorful animations, and cheerful rewards keep kids encouraged — there are no wrong answers, no timers, and no pressure. Just praise, balloons, and bubbles for every win! 🎈

👪 MADE FOR KIDS, LOVED BY PARENTS
• Simple, kid-friendly interface toddlers can navigate alone
• Guided hints and tutorials so no one gets stuck
• A Parent Zone to keep grown-up settings out of little hands
• Works offline, so it is ready for car trips and flights.
• Available in 18 languages, including English, Spanish, French, German, Portuguese, Italian, Turkish, Japanese, Korean, Chinese, Vietnamese and more

Whether it's quiet time at home, a long car ride, or learning fun before bed, Kids Puzzle keeps your child happily engaged and learning something new every day.

Download Kids Puzzle now and watch your toddler learn, play, and grow — one puzzle at a time! 🌟
